claim: Protected patient class-centroid correspondence carried by synthetic images and pair metadata can add utility for a learner excluded from distillation and selection.

data.private_origin_remains: private_train; previously used for classifier selection and Rwide diagnostic training

E1.name: DINOv2 ViT-B/14 without registers
E1.pretraining_scope: LVD-142M public release; no patient-level pretraining exclusion certificate

projection.fit_on: public813 only, unlabelled, patient-uniform image weights

E2.name: ImageNet ResNet18 IMAGENET1K_V1
E2.role: fixed-feature pair-aware reuse, excluded from synthetic objective and all bank/hyperparameter selection
E2.history: architecture used in earlier branch; only distillation/selection exclusion in this branch is claimed

preprocess.matching_augmentation: none; same fixed preprocessing defines real and synthetic risks
preprocess.encoder_mode: eval; all parameters and buffers frozen

D.shuffle: private mixed102 negative centroids only; public mixed3 fixed; nonDP only

bank.initialization: same public image for cell j and j+64; 64 hash-selected distinct public patients per bank; label-independent image choice; common across A/B/C/D
bank.output: canonical uint8 grayscale PNG; final readouts recomputed from decoded PNG
bank.permutation_rule: fixed private-patient derangement, shared by all D banks

optimization.tv: mean absolute horizontal plus vertical pixel difference
optimization.anchor: mean squared pixel difference from the common jittered initialization
optimization.gradient: whole-bank feature loss followed by frozen-encoder replay VJP; not an average of per-microbatch moment losses
optimization.nonfinite: technical abort; no parameter/step reduction based on utility

readout.primary_train: synthetic banks only; no private pixels; C/D use declared point and pair roles
readout.reference: E1 and E2 exact real-data point/relation readouts, diagnostic only; DP comparator uses E1 released moments
readout.C_D_relation_off: same 64 point images, beta=0, do not silently add relation images to point bank

evaluation.aggregation: metric per bank, then mean; not ensemble prediction
evaluation.bootstrap: reuse existing 2000 patient-cluster counts, paired across arms and banks; 95 percent intervals, exploratory development

gate.interpretation: development investment signal only, not final significance or DP success

compatibility.model: same corrected ResNet18 BCE kernel as historical branch
compatibility.synthetic_labels: assigned objective labels, not expert radiological ground truth

dp_future.counts: protected in joint query; add public exact sums then normalize
dp_future.noisy_count_rule: floor class counts at1; relation count clipped to [1,min(class counts)]
dp_future.moment_repair: fixed unit-mean / PSD covariance / trace-cap postprocessing for direct and synthetic targets; optional design chosen prospectively, not mathematical necessity
dp_future.private_randomness: future runtime must implement protected independent noise; deterministic public seeds are not a privacy release
dp_future.composition: separate summaries/releases require joint accounting; synthetic banks sharing one summary are postprocessing

runtime.profile_changes_allowed: microbatch/IO only with full-bank gradient parity; no objective/arms/hyperparameters based on efficacy
runtime.resume: unchanged contract; exact optimizer/RNG state and completed-artifact hashes; no best checkpoint choice
